reason: The README clearly describes a user-initiated cross-session reference plugin that captures selected conversation nodes and injects them as persistent session-recall context, so memory-context is the primary category.

summaries.zh: 用于从其他会话选择用户消息并将其作为捕获的上下文引用注入当前对话。
summaries.en: A plugin for selecting user messages from other conversations and injecting their captured context into the current conversation as references.

capabilities: Reads user-selected nodes from another conversation in the browser
Captures selected conversation context at confirmation time
Injects captured context into the current conversation through a host pre-step hook
Adds a composer picker and reference chips for cross-session references
